text: This report recommends that City Council approve the proposed alterations under Section 33 of the Ontario Heritage Act for the heritage property at 462 Wellington Street West, in connection with the proposed redevelopment of the site. This report also recommends that City Council grant authority to enter into a Heritage Easement Agreement for this property. The property at 462 Wellington Ave West is listed on the City of Toronto's Heritage Register. It is also considered as contributing within the Council-approved King-Spadina Heritage Conservation District (under appeal). At its meeting on May 11 and 12, 2022, City Council issued a Notice of Intention to Designate under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act for this property.
